Added core logic story for expiration and rotation

stories.title: Token Schema and Storage Model
stories.description: Define and implement the data schema for bearer tokens including fields for token value (hashed), issued_at, expires_at, rotation_version, and revocation_status. Persist tokens in a secure store and ensure compatibility with existing GPTReader authentication flow.

stories.title: Token Expiration and Rotation Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to enforce token expiration based on expires_at and support token rotation by issuing new tokens and invalidating prior versions. Ensure rotation is atomic and prevents race conditions or reuse of stale tokens.

stories.title: Token Validation Middleware Integration
stories.description: Integrate lifecycle-aware token validation into GPTReader request handling, ensuring every request checks expiration, rotation status, and revocation before allowing access. Update middleware or entrypoint validation accordingly.
